question: 沿“KG-GPT/RoG→MetaQA→跳数与指标/知识来源”比较两篇实验。RoG 中 Freebase 与 Wiki-Movies 分别承担什么角色？每个角色须给出原文。
answer: RoG 原文将 Freebase 定位为 KGQA 基准的“背景知识图谱”：其对 WebQSP 与 CWQ 的表述是“Freebase ... is the background knowledge graph for both datasets”。[chunk_229cb41ae3582cc199c9ee25c4956269] 同时，RoG 构造知识图谱统计表把 Freebase 与 Wiki-Movie 并列列出实体、关系和三元组数量，属于其“constructed knowledge graphs”之一。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 关于 Wiki-Movies，RoG 原文说明“MetaQA-3hop dataset ... is based on Wiki-Movies KGs”，即 Wiki-Movies 是 MetaQA-3hop 所依托的知识图谱；该处只描述数据集来源，并给出从训练集选 1000 个样本。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 但这一步是否就是 RoG 在 MetaQA 上的实验设置，原文该引句未直接说明，流程证据不足。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 比较两篇时，KG-GPT 的 MetaQA 结果表按 1-hop/2-hop/3-hop 报告 Hits@1，[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4] 而所给 RoG 证据没有 MetaQA 指标数值或跳数结果；因此无法据这些原文做 RoG 与 KG-GPT 在 MetaQA 上的指标比较，缺失须明确。[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]

EXPERIMENT
In our experiments, we aim to answer the following research questions: RQ1: Can RoG achieve
state-of-the-art performance on the KGQA tasks? RQ2: Can the planning module of RoG be inte-
grated with other LLMs to improve their performance? RQ3: Can RoG conduct faithful reasoning
and generate interpretable reasoning results?
5.1
EXPERIMENT SETTINGS
Datasets. We evaluate the reasoning ability of RoG on two benchmark KGQA datasets: WebQues-
tionSP (WebQSP) (Yih et al., 2016) and Complex WebQuestions (CWQ) (Talmor & Berant, 2018),
which contain up to 4-hop questions. Freebase (Bollacker et al., 2008) is the background knowledge
graph for both datasets, which contains around 88 million entities, 20 thousand relations, and 126
million triples. The details of the datasets are described in Appendix A.4.
3The relation name r∗could be split into multiple tokens.

hibits certain limitations. KG-GPT achieves an ac-
